posts.text: I would load up on 1986 Fleer basketball instead of the loads of (overproduced, worthless) 1986 Topps baseball that I collected.
Mason got to ride shotgun in a Model S Plaid.  The Tesla driver gunned it.  Probably the fastest civilian car I’ve ever been in.  He loved it.
The Waymo I saw was a Jaguar.
And Suntrax has been doing autonomous vehicle testing for longer than that.
There was a cybercab right next to it.  LOL.

I’d didn’t do a test in the Waymo but Mason sat in it for part of the press conference (because it was 100 degrees and the car was air conditioned) and it looked good.  Just a different setup than the cybercab or robotaxi.  

My understanding is that it has performed well in the select locations it is operating in Florida.
“Roads?  Where we’re going we don’t need…  roads.”
